svg.title: bamboo-stencil-2-neg-50mm - 50 mm OD / 46 mm ID
svg.desc: Fusion 360 coordinates use 96 SVG units per inch and are centered on 0,0. Gray is one boolean-unioned printed solid; white is open. The exact ring and source white background print, while the bamboo artwork is open. Short printed passages reconnect every background island.
